description: Firewall and intrusion protection for Windows Servers and PCs - bans password guessers and port scanners automatically.
notes: Coinetic AI Security runs as a Windows service and starts the free 30-day trial (all features, no payment details).
Installing through Scoop accepts the licence agreement: https://coinetic.io/eula
Coinetic updates itself; uninstalling asks for a confirmation on purpose (tamper protection). Unattended removal: https://coinetic.io/deploy-coinetic
pre_install: if (-not (is_admin)) { abort "$app requires admin rights to $cmd (it installs a Windows service)." }

script: Write-Host 'Installing Coinetic AI Security - you accept the licence agreement https://coinetic.io/eula'
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { abort "CoineticSetup.exe ended with code $($p.ExitCode) - see https://coinetic.io/deploy-coinetic" }

pre_uninstall: if (-not (is_admin)) { abort "$app requires admin rights to $cmd." }

script: else { warn 'Coinetic AI Security is not installed (no Apps and Features entry).' }
